newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Scottish doctor killed in S.Africa's Zulu province.
newsitem.headline: Scottish doctor killed in S.Africa's Zulu province.

text.p: A Scottish doctor was stabbed and shot to death by three robbers in South Africa's eastern KwaZulu-Natal province, police said on Friday.

Spence William Alexander, 38, had left his surgery in Empangeni, a small industrial town west of the Indian Ocean port of Richards Bay, when he was stopped by the three men on Thursday night who demanded his minibus, police said in a statment.

"The vehicle stopped at a service Station...When the doctor tried to alight from the vehicle, he was stabbed and shot by his assailants," police said. He died of his wounds in hospital. The attackers escaped with the vehicle.
